description: This file defines the implementation of the DeviceListHandler class, which handles HTTP GET and POST requests related to device listing in a WebRTC operator context within the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: DeviceListHandler
classes.description: A class that handles HTTP requests for listing devices in the WebRTC operator component.

methods.name: DeviceListHandler::DoGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve the list of device IDs and returns them as a JSON array.

methods.name: DeviceListHandler::DoPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests, currently returns a 404 Not Found status.
